name: lazydev
description: An MCP server where a lead agent delegates coding tasks to worker agents in isolated git worktrees, verifies the results, and asks a human before merging.

scripts.check: node --check fake-harness.mjs && node --check lazydev-bin.mjs && node --check lazydev-clean.mjs && node --check lazydev-harnesses.mjs && node --check lazydev-integrate.mjs && node --check lazydev-poc.mjs && node --check mcp-server.mjs && node --check mcp-smoke.mjs && node --check selftest.mjs
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run selftest && npm run smoke
